ModDescription: Choose who is in your party. The Party tab lists everyone you have recruited; tick the ones you want with you and press Apply.

Settings.Name: Maximum party size
Settings.Description: How many characters can be in the active party, including your own. Applied when you load a save and whenever you change it.

Settings.Name: Bring new members to you
Settings.Description: When a companion joins from camp, move them to your character. Off: they walk in on their own as in vanilla.

Settings.Name: No party changes in combat
Settings.Description: Refuse to change the party while anyone in it is in combat, as the vanilla dismiss button does.

Settings.Name: Ask before a long rest
Settings.Description: The camp has four beds. If your party is larger, End the Day is held and you are asked which four to keep tonight. The others go to camp and rejoin when you wake up.

Settings.Name: Ask before the Grymforge raft
Settings.Description: The Ebonlake raft carries four. If your party is larger, the crossing is held and you are asked which four to take. The others go to camp and rejoin when the raft lands.

Settings.Name: Restore the full party afterwards
Settings.Description: Put the trimmed party back after the rest or the crossing. Off: use the Restore button on the Party tab when you want them back.
